title: Partial Differential Equations and Complex Analysis
title_variants: Partial Differential Equation and Complex Analysis
syllabus_note: Module contents as published in the KTU 2019-scheme syllabus; topic split refined against real papers (Dec 2020 - Jun 2026).

modules.title: Partial Differential Equations
modules.syllabus: Formation of PDEs by elimination of arbitrary constants and functions; equations solvable by direct integration; Lagrange's linear equation; non-linear first order equations (Charpit's method); method of separation of variables.

topics.name: Formation of PDE: eliminating arbitrary constants
Formation of PDE: eliminating arbitrary functions
Solution by direct integration
Lagrange's linear equation (Pp + Qq = R)
Non-linear first order PDE: Charpit's method
Method of separation of variables (first order PDE)

modules.title: One-dimensional Wave and Heat Equations
modules.syllabus: One dimensional wave equation: vibrating string, derivation, solution by separation of variables, D'Alembert's solution. One dimensional heat equation: derivation and solution by separation of variables.

topics.name: Wave equation: derivation and assumptions
Wave equation: possible solutions by separation of variables
Vibrating string problems (initial displacement/velocity, Fourier series)
D'Alembert's solution of the wave equation
Heat equation: derivation and assumptions
Heat equation: possible solutions by separation of variables
Heat flow in a rod problems (temperature distribution, steady state)

modules.title: Complex Variable: Differentiation
modules.syllabus: Complex functions, limit, continuity, derivative, analytic functions, Cauchy-Riemann equations, harmonic functions, harmonic conjugate; conformal mapping (w = z^2, e^z, 1/z, sin z), linear fractional transformations.

topics.name: Limits and continuity of complex functions
Analytic functions and Cauchy-Riemann equations
Harmonic functions and harmonic conjugates (constructing analytic f)
Properties and proofs of analytic functions
Conformal mapping: images under w = z^2, e^z, 1/z, sin z
Linear fractional (bilinear) transformations and fixed points

modules.title: Complex Variable: Integration
modules.syllabus: Line integrals in the complex plane (by indefinite integration and by path representation), Cauchy's integral theorem, Cauchy's integral formula, derivatives of analytic functions, Taylor and Maclaurin series.

topics.name: Line integrals (path representation / indefinite integration)
Cauchy's integral theorem
Cauchy's integral formula and derivatives of analytic functions
Taylor and Maclaurin series

modules.title: Complex Variable: Residue Integration
modules.syllabus: Laurent series, zeros and singularities, residues, Cauchy's residue theorem, evaluation of real integrals.

topics.name: Laurent series (in given regions)
Zeros and singularities (classification)
Computing residues
Cauchy's residue theorem: contour integrals
Real integrals of trigonometric type (0 to 2pi)
Improper real integrals (-inf to inf)
